title: The 8 Levels of Smart Fridge Stalking
house: A sun-drenched coastal suburb in California where everyone's net monthly income glows brightly on their foreheads, and the smart home refrigerators gossip before the owners even wake up.
links: The barista in Level 2 mentions a quiet man in a tailored suit who always tips in crisp hundred-dollar bills.
The neon-lit 24/7 bodega from Level 4 is where the damaged smart screen ends up in the dumpster.
The rooftop pool party in Level 6 overlooks the exact apartment complex where Level 1 lives.
The rich CEO in Level 8 finally reveals he was the one who bought the broken fridge parts from Level 4.

levels.name: Mia, 22, Intern
levels.story: The 8 levels of reading your date's chat history on his smart fridge. Level 1. Level 1: 1,450 dollars a month – and I'm staring at my new date's smart fridge screen in absolute panic. My forehead glows a pathetic 1,450 dollars, while Tyler's glowing 12,000 dollars screams we live in different galaxies. I only wanted to check if he had oat milk for my coffee. Instead, the oversized glass door lit up with a notification preview. His friends were typing about me in real time. Are you really bringing that grocery store peach with the broke forehead again? Tyler's reply flashed across the stainless steel in glowing blue letters. She's cute for a cheap date, I'll dump her after taco night. My stem practically trembled on my peach-fuzz head. I dropped my coffee mug right onto the spotless marble floor. You shouldn't touch things you can't afford, Mia. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Leo, 28, Barista
levels.story: The 8 levels of reading your date's chat history on his smart fridge. Level 2. Level 2: 2,850 dollars a month – and I'm wiping down espresso cups while my regular customer, Tyler, leaves his luxury keys on the counter. My forehead glows 2,850 dollars, completely mid-tier in this coastal town. Yesterday, Mia the peach rushed through my cafe in tears after reading her date's smart fridge messages. Today, Tyler walks in looking completely unfazed, ordering a quad-shot oat latte and dropping a hundred-dollar bill. You're working the morning shift again, Lemon? I didn't say a word about Mia. Instead, I swiped open my own pocket tablet, mirroring the smart home hub he left connected. His fridge back home was currently uploading every single voice memo and chat transcript to a public neighborhood drive. I pressed play on the kitchen speaker right behind him. His own voice echoed through the whole cafe. You've got nerve for a bean-grinder. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Oliver, 29, Delivery Driver
levels.story: The 8 levels of reading your date's chat history on his smart fridge. Level 5. Level 5: 3,800 dollars a month – and I'm double-parked in front of a luxury high-rise, trying to deliver a heavy package containing Tyler's replacement smart fridge screen. My forehead glows 3,800 dollars from endless overtime shifts behind the wheel of my van. Sam the bodega owner texted me coordinates to intercept the package before it reached Tyler's penthouse. Inside the cardboard box wasn't just glass and LCD pixels. It was a complete hardware keylogger designed to siphon chat transcripts. I dropped the heavy crate right onto the sidewalk with a thunderous crash. The cardboard split open, revealing a blinking red LED unit. You're messing with forces you don't understand. You'll see that in Level 6.
